title: An English editor with explanations
description: An edit to an email and a short note on why a different wording was suggested.

blocks.text: In a language that is not your own it is hard to judge whether the text has become more natural or merely more formal. A ready-made answer does not always teach you to choose for yourself.

quote.text: English is my second language, I always have to double check my text or email and even when I think they are perfect. This app finds things and correct them.

blocks.text: Show the original and the changes, and explain the differences in meaning and in style. Let people accept an individual edit or keep their own phrasing.
Do not load the email down with a lecture. The explanation should refer to a specific place and keep the author’s original intent.
